cleaned_text: HDFC MUTUAL FUND SCHEME INFORMATION DOCUMENT (SID) HDFC Flexi Cap Fund An open-ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks. Investment Objective: To generate capital appreciation / income from a portfolio, predominantly invested in equity and equity-related instruments. Benchmark: Nifty 500 TRI (Total Returns Index). Riskometer: The risk of the scheme is classified as Very High. Minimum Subscription: Minimum SIP Amount: Rs. 100 per month. Minimum Lumpsum Amount: Rs. 100. Expense Ratio: Direct Plan: 0.95% per annum. Regular Plan: 1.65% per annum. Exit Load: - For redemption or switch-out within 365 days from the date of allotment: 1.00% of the applicable NAV. - For redemption or switch-out after 365 days from the date of allotment: Nil.
